newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's Ampol plans open access terminals.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's Ampol plans open access terminals.

text.p: Petroleum refiner and retailer Australian Petroleum Pty Ltd (APPL), which trades as Ampol, said on Thursday it plans an open access to its seaboard fuel terminals and calls for industry deregulation soon.
APPL is jointly owned by Pioneer International Ltd and Caltex Australia Ltd.

"Ampol sees no genuine impediment to deregulation by early 1997 and I urge the government to implement its election commitment to deregulation as soon as possible," Ampol managing director Ian Blackburne said in a statement.
